title: Fallen Crown and Death
description: A surreal dark artwork features an ornate golden crown with a cracked heart center and white pearls resting on a black textured mound. To the right, a skeletal figure wearing a smaller crown and insect-like wings holds a dripping black heart, set against a vibrant purple background with circular patterns, orbs, and black splatters.
prompt: Surreal dark artwork showing a large ornate golden crown with a cracked black heart at its center and white pearl beads resting on a black mound. To the right a skeletal fairy-like figure with large intricate wings and a small crown holds a dripping black heart, all set on a textured purple background with white circles, black ink splatters and decorative linework.
